description: Defines the internal readonly struct ObserverGrainId within the Orleans.Runtime namespace. This struct identifies a client-side observer object, providing methods to create, compare, and parse observer grain IDs, which are represented by GrainId instances with specific conventions.

classes.name: ObserverGrainId
classes.description: Represents an internal identifier for a client-side observer object, implementing equality, comparison, and string formatting interfaces, and providing static methods to create and interpret observer IDs.

methods.name: Create
methods.description: Creates a new ObserverGrainId instance for the given ClientGrainId, with an option to generate a new GUID-based scoped ID.

methods.name: Create
methods.description: Creates a new ObserverGrainId instance for the given ClientGrainId and specified scoped IdSpan.

methods.name: IsObserverGrainId
methods.description: Determines whether a given GrainId represents an observer ID based on internal conventions.

methods.name: TryParse
methods.description: Attempts to parse a GrainId into an ObserverGrainId, returning true if successful.
